independent_math_summary: Independent full3D exact cover searches all54 possible oriented colored rods before exposed-color pruning. Only A has a nine-rod witness; B/C/D/E exhaust infeasible.
substantive_direction_assessed: A real visible GG subspan exists in several choices and does not determine a complete GGW rod. Using it as a whole rod either repeats the earlier rejected partial-pair shortcut without a new information role or implies a fixed/fictitious rod decomposition. Black-width grouping can still imply a physical block boundary; colored block-edge identity has an additional source-to-composed-piece interpretation risk. No closed or false decomposition was drawn; no new human-clear substantive binding retained.
